verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents passkey support (docs-8). It ships iOS and Android apps, browser extensions including Firefox, and a desktop app (comm-14, comm-7, docs-9), so cross-ecosystem availability of stored passkeys is implied. The evidence never explicitly says passkeys sync across those platforms. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that passkeys sync across devices and ecosystems, named Windows and Linux desktop support, and hands-on corroboration of cross-platform passkey use.
